mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id, f.friend_id, f.remark, f.create_time, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.status FROM chat_friend f LEFT JOIN chat_user u ON u.id = f.friend_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM chat_friend WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND friend_id = #{friendId}
